lines: Woh firaaq aur woh wisaal kahan?
couplets.en: Where are those partings and those reunions now?
Where are those nights and days, those months and years?

lines: Thi woh ek shakhs ke tasavvur se.
couplets.en: The thought of one person gave it all its grace.
Where is that grace of imagining now?
Where are those nights and days, those months and years?
It takes much to weep tears of blood.

lines: Dil mein taaqat, jigar mein haal kahan?
couplets.en: Where is the strength of heart, the spirit to endure it?
Where are those nights and days, those months and years?
I wear myself out with worldly cares.

lines: Main kahan aur yeh wabaal kahan?
couplets.en: How did I come to be saddled with all this?
Where are those nights and days, those months and years?

lines: Woh firaaq aur woh wisaal kahan?
